accounts.description: List of SMTP accounts to configure. Each account defines connection details for sending mail.

from_address.description: Email address used as the 'From' header.

host.description: SMTP server hostname or IP address.

log_file.description: Path to log file (if syslog is disabled or to supplement syslog).

name.description: Unique identifier for this account (used with 'account' directive).

password.description: Password for SMTP authentication (store securely; consider using msmtprc with permissions 600).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to client certificate for mutual TLS (optional).

tls_key_file.description: Path to client private key for mutual TLS (optional).

tls_starttls.description: Use STARTTLS after connecting (for non-TLS ports like 587).

tls_trust_file.description: Path to CA certificate file for TLS validation (e.g., /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt).

aliases.description: Key-value map of email aliases (e.g., {'admin': 'admin@example.com', 'support': 'team@example.com'}), where keys are alias names and values are target email addresses.

default_account.description: Name of the default account to use when no specific account is selected.
